name: postUrl
label: Post URL
help: LinkedIn URL of the post to react to. Provide this or the post URN.

name: postUrn
label: Post URN
help: URN of the post, accepted instead of the post URL. For example, urn:li:activity:1234567890123456789.

name: reactionType
label: Reaction Type
help: Type of reaction to add to the post

name: companyUrl
label: Company URL
help: LinkedIn company page URL. If specified, the reaction will be added on behalf of the company page.
